decision.article_title: 「千问Go！」即将发布，刚帮用户在淘宝申请52元价保退款 - 雷峰网
decision.reason: Cross-checked Qwen Go user examples (52 RMB e-commerce price-protection refund and flight compensation), but autonomous platform navigation/calls/payments require active external AI and transaction integrations beyond zero-runtime-cost MVP constraint.
